title: Romans Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Romans 5: peace with God through faith, rejoicing in sufferings, and the contrast between the one trespass and the free gift.

questions.text: What does the chapter say we have, being justified by faith?
questions.explanation: It says that being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

answers.text: Peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ
A place among the prophets
The reward that is owed to us
The law written on our hearts

questions.text: What does suffering produce, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: It says that suffering produces perseverance, and perseverance proven character, and proven character hope.

answers.text: Wrath, which produces judgment and condemnation
Knowledge, which produces boasting and then pride
Perseverance, which produces proven character and then hope
Weakness, which produces fear and unbelief

questions.text: How has God's love been poured into our hearts?
questions.explanation: It says hope does not disappoint us, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

answers.text: Through the law of Moses
Through the Holy Spirit who was given to us
Through the words of the prophets
Through our own perseverance

questions.text: For whom does the chapter say Christ died at the right time?
questions.explanation: It says that while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

answers.text: For the righteous
For the doers of the law
For the twelve tribes only
For the ungodly

questions.text: What does the chapter say about our state when Christ died for us?
questions.explanation: It says God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

answers.text: We were already reconciled
We were seeking after God
We were yet sinners
We were under the law and blameless

questions.text: How does the chapter say we were reconciled to God while we were enemies?
questions.explanation: It says that while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son.

answers.text: Through the death of his Son
Through the blood of the sacrifices
Through the preaching of the apostles
Through our own repentance

questions.text: How does the chapter say sin entered into the world?
questions.explanation: It says that sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men.

answers.text: Through the law, and death through the law
Through the nations, and death through war
Through Moses, and death through disobedience
Through one man, and death through sin

questions.text: Between whom does the chapter say death reigned?
questions.explanation: It says that death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins were not like Adam's disobedience.

answers.text: From Abraham until David
From Adam until Moses
From Moses until Christ
From Adam until Abraham

questions.text: What does the chapter say happened where sin abounded?
questions.explanation: It says the law came in that the trespass might abound, but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly.

answers.text: Wrath was poured out without measure
The law was taken away
Grace abounded more exceedingly
Death reigned over the nations

questions.text: Through what does the chapter say grace reigns to eternal life?
questions.explanation: It says that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

answers.text: Through righteousness, through Jesus Christ our Lord
Through the law of Moses
Through the obedience of the many
Through suffering and perseverance
